# `files` operations

5 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### files.list

**Show project files**

List a project directory, folders first. Paths remain confined to the selected project root.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `directory` | string |  | `""` |  |
| `hidden` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `generated` | boolean |  | `false` |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.list '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### files.read

**Open source file**

Read up to 1 MiB of UTF-8 source and its SHA-256 revision.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `file` | string | yes |  | non-empty |

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.read '{"path":"<path>","file":"<file>"}'
```

### files.write

**Save source file**

Atomically save text when if_match equals the current SHA-256; use an empty revision only for new files.

Annotations: **destructive**, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `file` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `text` | string | yes |  | up to 1048576 characters |
| `if_match` | string | yes |  | matching `([a-f0-9]{64})?` |

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.write '{"path":"<path>","file":"<file>","text":"<text>","if_match":"<if_match>"}'
```

### files.search

**Search project**

Bounded source search, skipping generated trees and symlinks; returns file, line, column and matching text.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, closed world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty |
| `query` | string | yes |  | non-empty, up to 1000 characters |
| `regex` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `case_sensitive` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `hidden` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | `200` | 1 to 1000 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.search '{"path":"<path>","query":"<query>"}'
```
